answer: The kernel register is checked at draw time, spiral lists the eligible set, and nadir seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 66 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. Reaching eligibility takes 66 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an hostile operator pays for every seat it wants. A farm of 129 pays that 262 times. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
